outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry dot/pseudocolor plots showing individual cell events with gating percentages; these are scatter-type plots where each point is an individual data point, so overlay of separate individual points is not applicable.
Flow cytometry scatter plots of individual cell events with gates for CD19lo CD98+ and PC populations; individual events are already the data points shown.
Flow cytometry scatter plots showing gating for NP-binding GC and MBC populations; each dot represents an individual cell event, no averaging is depicted.
Color-coded overlay scatter plots (MBC, GC, naive) of CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2; these are scatter plots of individual cell events, not averaged summary statistics.
Flow cytometry scatter plots showing MBC subset gating (CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2); individual cell events are displayed directly, not an average requiring overlaid points.
